baselines.name: CUB inclusive scan with identical producer and affine operator

costs.scope: complete device-resident producer+scan/carry pipeline; allocation and transfers excluded and disclosed

quality.probe: held-out depth-dependent direct-vs-tree error and same-mean different-order witness; GPU two-level source interval trace

limitations: restricted affine family cannot implement arbitrary nonlinear recurrence
CUB beats custom scan in measured device-resident cases
synthetic untrained fixture does not establish biological value
conclusion: Retain composable conditional affine summary as one bounded candidate, using CUB as the preferred measured executor; no production API or learned biological claim.
